text:
Maya Patel: Heads up—Peregrine Health onboarding. We need to run a compact lab + 1hr office hours next week to hit their go-live prep. Prework needs to go out by Mon EOD. Who can host the sessions and own preread?
Devon Li: I can host the EMEA session — Tue 09:00-10:00 CET works for me.
Maya Patel: Perfect, Devon. Draft agenda below — feel free to tweak. Also need preread (5 slides + checklist) sent to customer by Monday. @Anika Singh can you own that?
Maya Patel: ```
Agenda (60m):
1) 10m — Welcome + objectives (CS + Eng)
2) 25m — Guided run-through: quickstart + Dedicated migration checklist (live demo)
3) 15m — Q&A (product & ops)
4) 10m — Next steps, handoffs, and action items
Optional: 30m deep-dive breakout for engineers (separate invite)
```
Anika Singh: I can own the preread. I'll draft a 5-slide preread + onboarding checklist (API key, sample data, account mapping, SSO notes). Will share a link to the doc by Friday for review.
Sam Torres: Americas slot — Wed 11:00 PT is available on my side. I can cover Dedicated ops and autoscaling guidance.
Maya Patel: Great. So tentative: EMEA Tue 09:00 CET (Devon lead), Americas Wed 11:00 PT (Sam lead). Limit attendees to 12 per session for the hands-on portion. Please add attendee names to the sheet: https://redwood.example.com/sheets/peregrine-onboard (edit access)
Devon Li: Quick question — do we want an engineer breakout built into the main invite or as a follow-up? Could be heavy for product folks.
Sam Torres: I'd prefer a separate optional 30-min breakout after the main session for engineers to dig into KV cache and batching config.
Anika Singh: I'll add that optional 30-min deep-dive block to the calendar invites. Also adding a short preread checklist: 
- Confirm API key & env access
- Upload sample dataset (<= 10MB)
- Provide list of routes/models they plan to use
- Contacts for infra/security
Maya Patel: Awesome. @Devon can you confirm the EMEA invite title copy and speaker list? I'll draft the email for preread + calendar invites once speakers confirmed.
Devon Li: Confirmed — I'll be the primary host, and inviteing @Maya and @Sam as co-hosts. Draft invite title: "Peregrine Health: Compact Onboarding Lab + Office Hours (EMEA)"
Maya Patel: Sounds good. Also notes for CS-Bot: create provisional calendar invites after we confirm speakers and attach preread when Anika links it.
CS-Bot: Created provisional invites for both sessions and added provisional attendee limit of 12. Waiting on preread link from Anika to finalize attachments.
Anika Singh: Shared preread draft here: https://redwood.example.com/docs/peregrine-preread-v1 (comments open). Please review by Friday EOD.
Sam Torres: Reviewed the preread — added a short ops checklist under slide 4. Looks good. I'll handle the Dedicated ops slide during the Americas session.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. Final action items: Devon finalize EMEA invite title & speakers, Sam confirm Americas co-hosts, Anika finalize preread by Fri EOD, Maya will send the customer email with preread Monday morning. If you can host, react with :thumbsup: and add your name to the sheet.
Devon Li: :thumbsup:
Sam Torres: :thumbsup:
Anika Singh: :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Closing out — will post final calendar invites here once CS-Bot attaches the preread. Thanks!
